summary: A strong shortlist choice for contemporary craft, design and creative neighbourhood wandering if your Chiang Mai dates overlap 5–13 December 2026. The organizer confirms this 12th edition and its Local Thunders, Global Transformation theme; the detailed programme is still incomplete. Think distributed exhibitions, markets, talks and workshops rather than one attraction with a single ticket.
whyGo: Meet northern Thai creativity beyond temple sightseeing through contemporary design, craft and local makers.
The announced 2026 highlights include a creative Pop Market, music under LABBfest. and Scents Asia exhibitions and showcases.
Combine a few chosen installations with cafés and neighbourhood exploration rather than attempting every venue.
skipIf: You need a fully scheduled, single-venue attraction
You dislike walking between venues or checking individual event details
duration: Suggested allowance: half a day for one neighbourhood; one or two days for several exhibitions and a workshop. These are planning estimates.
cost: 2026 festival-wide admission and individual workshop charges are unconfirmed. Budget separately for purchases, food, transport and any ticketed sessions; do not assume everything is free.
hours: Venue-specific hours remain unconfirmed. Scents Asia currently advertises 10:00–20:00, 5–13 December, at TCDC Chiang Mai; this is not the schedule for the whole festival.
bestTime: Choose an afternoon with flexibility into the evening, subject to the final exhibition and performance timetable.
gettingThere: Official information identifies Old Town, Tha Phae–Chang Moi and TCDC Chiang Mai. Use the eventual programme map to group nearby stops; arrange a taxi or ride-hailing car between distant clusters. TCDC/CEA address: 1/1 Muang Samut Road, Chang Moi.
booking: Check the official programme again near departure. Reserve any capacity-limited workshop or performance only once its own listing specifies registration, language and price.
accessibility: No festival-wide step-free-access guarantee found. Ask individual venues about entrances, stairs, toilets and seating before committing to a route.
practicalTips: Save a small route and venue opening times offline.
Check whether talks and workshops offer English participation.
Wear comfortable walking shoes and leave space for food and browsing.
Treat announcement highlights as provisional until individual listings appear.
decemberNotes: The repeatedly confirmed dates are 5–13 December 2026. An official Thai about page contains conflicting legacy copy, including 6–14 December; prefer the current English announcement and 2026 visitor guide, then reconfirm before arranging travel around the festival.
uncertainties: Final participating venues, daily schedules, admission, workshop bookings and accessibility are not yet verified.
The programme page returned no matching programmes during research.
The image is an organizer archive photograph, not a preview of a confirmed 2026 workshop.
